hash_scope: Canonical JSON excluding contract_hash. Frozen criteria additionally bind exact bytes of the approved spec, three v0.08 schemas, compiler corpus, held-out partition, execution corpus, evaluation plan, and preregistration preflight by explicit failure-condition hashes.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS and every frozen primary/guardrail metric meets target.
All metrics reconcile to raw frozen corpus results and denominator snapshots.
All active regressions PASS and meaningful defects are considered for permanent regression memory.
Spec, schemas, corpora, evaluation-plan, preflight, and contract hashes remain intact.
Independent evaluator recommendation is recorded and evaluator differs from implementation actor.
No critical open defect remains; rollback, retrospective, continuation state, version-local snapshots, manifest-last shipping seal, and extracted-package verification are complete.
Because same-cycle synthetic evidence is not organizationally independent, maximum classification is PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL.

requirements.description: Compile governed traceability and source-task evidence into deterministic task records.
Block compilation while unresolved owner-decision discovery actions remain.
Derive prerequisite edges only from frozen allowed provenance sources.
Reject combined dependency cycles with exact cycle source-task set.
Enforce frozen atomicity bounds without inventing task splits.
Create deterministic conflict zones for shared write scopes.
Compute pairwise parallel eligibility from dependency paths and write conflicts.
Expose deterministic compiler API and CLI JSON behavior.
Preserve sealed-parent behavior and active regressions.
Evaluate against frozen development and held-out task-compiler projects.
Require independent verification, reconciliation, rollback, snapshots, and manifest-last sealing.
Represent task execution state only through append-only events bound to immutable compiled graph hash.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.08 fails, preserve all v0.08 frozen/failed evidence and continue using sealed v0.07 executable behavior; do not rewrite parent ledgers or regressions.
